capability: App versions: the platform keeps each release of an app's configuration and extensions as a version, a snapshot that the developer releases to the app's users and can roll back (Shopify: Versions, app versions, app version, App versioning, app:deploy)
note: Made by the coordinator from the held pass (held/new.tsv, 31 October; held/new-proposals.md, N14), in M-amend. Its places of its own: the Dev Dashboard's item Versions on an app's page (observed-sh@e38dc17e3:structures/shopify/dev-dashboard-nav/app-431413264385/items.jsonl line 9, SH-23:46) and the Partner Dashboard's route /:orgId/apps/:appId/versions (observed-sh@e38dc17e3:structures/shopify/partners-dashboard-routes/partners.shopify.com@20261007T065956Z-published-partners-dashboard-js/items.jsonl line 70, SH-86:100). 'This command creates an app version, which is a snapshot of your app configuration and all extensions' (SH-98:52); the app's configuration 'is now a part of an app version and can be easily rolled back' (SH-57:3). Homonyms: not CM-API-006, the platform's versions of its API, nor Salla's theme versions (theme-versions-management, CM-SFR-001); nor CM-APP-010, settings held per store. Shopify only so far, and only in the held pass: no platform's concern-map statement names an app's versions, and Shopify's statements on deployments say nothing of a version (its cell). Its parent is apps: both Shopify dashboards put Versions on an app's own page.

note: Made by the coordinator from the held pass (held/new.tsv, 31 October; held/new-proposals.md, N15), in M-amend.
